README: Declared name→document mappings for the unlisted-shares price import. COMMITTED — these must survive every daily run.
An entry says: this name on the partner's list belongs to THIS document, stop guessing. It exists for the tail the
matcher cannot reach safely — names where our stored spelling lost or gained characters the heuristics cannot bridge
('IFincorp' for 'ICL Fincorp', 'Hur Solar' for 'HVR Solar'), and names short enough after repair that a guess could
Keyed by the TARGET document's slug. The values are the names as the partner's list writes them.
resolveUnlistedTarget checks this map FIRST, ahead of every heuristic including the exact tests: an entry here is an
operator decision and nothing below it gets a vote.
Matching is on the normalised name, so punctuation, case and the ltd/limited/private/india suffix words do not have
to be reproduced exactly. The list's own 'Unlisted Shares' / 'Price' boilerplate does not have to be stripped.
To add an entry: run the importer's dry run, find the row under 'POSSIBLE DUPLICATE' or 'matched N companies',
then put the incoming name under the slug of the document it belongs to. A slug that no document has is reported and
aborts the run, so a typo cannot silently do nothing.
After adding entries, npm run clean:unlisted-dupes --dry-run shows which duplicate documents they make deletable.
